Sources & methods

Project records

  • DoED · Hydropower plants over 1 MW ↗

    Projects in this register are labelled Operating. This is a registry classification and can include plants that are temporarily offline.

  • DoED · Hydropower construction licences over 1 MW ↗

    Projects in this register are labelled In development. The licence establishes the regulatory category. Actual construction progress may vary.

  • DoED · Solar power plants ↗ · Solar construction licences ↗
  • DoED · Cogeneration ↗ · AEPC · Wind energy ↗ · ADB · Chisapani hybrid ↗
  • Investment Board Nepal · Project status summary (PDF) ↗

    Where the project name and capacity match, the detail card can also show the board’s reported construction stage.

Map locations & coverage

Each map glyph marks the midpoint of a published coordinate range. This represents the approximate project area. The non-hydro directory also includes selected records without usable coordinates and labels those entries. Capacity and project status come from the cited record. BS dates use Nepal’s Bikram Sambat calendar.

National generation and trade

Nepal Electricity Authority · A Year in Review 2025/26 ↗ supplies the annual and monthly electricity figures. WECS · Energy Sector Synopsis Report 2024 ↗ supplies the wider energy balance. Each table links to its relevant source page.

Terrain & boundary

Shaded relief uses Mapzen Terrain Tiles on AWS ↗. The Nepal boundary comes from geoBoundaries / Open Data Nepal ↗, 2019 geometry, simplified and styled for display under CC BY 4.0.
